answer: One concrete lever: correlate the funding and invite graph across identities. Many masks run by a single operator share a backing wallet, a recruiter, and near-identical response timing, so their accounts crest the same ridge of behavior. Vouch edges between them ring hollow and self-referential, and payout paths keep docking at one wharf. To defeat this an attacker must buy genuinely independent capital sources and separate inviters for every mask, so each added sybil costs real, non-recoverable money rather than a free fork of one inference pipeline.
